commentary.text: 90+4' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao).
90+2' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' A lofted cross from Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
88' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

88' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
87' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
86' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) gets a yellow card.
86' It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
85' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
84' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) probably handled the ball.
83' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
82' Total attempts – 10:6.
80' 3 - 1 Goal! Inaki Williams gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
79' Ath Bilbao are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
77' Here is a change. Gorka Guruzeta is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao).
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alex Berenguer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
75' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
73' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
72' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
71' Celta Vigo win a corner.
71' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
70' Rough tackle by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas will be replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) replaces Hugo Alvarez.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Mikel Jauregizar.
63' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Jailson is replaced by Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo).
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) coming on for Adama Boiro.
62' Substitution. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hugo Sotelo walks off.
61' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 33:67.
60' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
58' Marcos Alonso rounds off a good move with a layoff to Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.

57' A neat pass finds Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Vicente Guaita denies him with a good save.
56' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Julen Agirrezabala comes off the line to clear the ball away.
55' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
53' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
52' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) gets booked for the first time in this match.
51' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

48' Vicente Guaita makes a brilliant save! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!

47' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Sanchez with no other option than to blow for a foul. Ath Bilbao have a free kick from a promising distance.
46' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alex Padilla (Ath Bilbao) comes on the pitch for Julen Agirrezabala.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
45+1' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' An attempted cross from Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
44' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.

40' 2 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Alex Berenguer showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the right post – 2:1.
38' The goal by Celta Vigo won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
37' Attention! Referee Jose Sanchez straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
37' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Jose Sanchez immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
35' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Julen Agirrezabala reacts superbly to deny him.
34' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
33' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
32' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
31' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jailson (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
30' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
29' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
27' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
25' 1 - 1 GOAL! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Julen Agirrezabala in goal.
24' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
23' Celta Vigo are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
22' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
21' Celta Vigo have a corner.
20' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
20' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
19' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
15' The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Celta Vigo.
13' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Poor challenge! Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
11' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
9' Wonderful movement by Celta Vigo. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
8' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Julen Agirrezabala intercepts the ball.
7' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
6' Jailson (Celta Vigo) trips an opposition player and Jose Sanchez signals a foul.
5' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make a change. Oscar Mingueza is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo).
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Close! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
Ath Bilbao will kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will referee today's match.
